description: Read a project or tender document (a purchase or project specification, a tender volume, a GTP / data schedule; a PDF of up to 80 pages and 20 MB, or its text) and answer what it asks for: every cable it lists built as a design by the designer's rules and checked against its rule set, the required / offered schedule beside the document's own required values with their pages, each requirement mapped to a requirement card or listed as having none, the conflicts (one parameter with two values, a printed construction against a requirement, a value against the standard the document names, a voltage outside IEC 60038, a schedule row with no construction) and the missing sections. An LLM (Claude) copies the document's values and pages; it decides nothing: every design, check, conflict and gap is the deterministic rules with their sources. A reading takes up to a few minutes, so the call starts a job and answers a poll link; the reading is held in memory for one hour, then gone, and the file is never stored. Here the document's text; a PDF goes to POST /api/v1/tender. Always paid: $4.00 up to 20 pages, $2.00 for each further 10 pages begun, up to 80 pages.

hint.description: A cable tag or a voltage to look for first.

lang.description: The language of the schedule's parameter names: any of the site's 15 (en, tr, de, nl, sv, fr, es, da, no, fi, it, ro, pl, cs, ru). Default en.

text.description: The document's text (a Word file turned into text); it counts one page per 1,700 characters begun.

name: read_tender
title: Read a tender document: cables built, requirements, schedule, conflicts and gaps
